| Wall fueling model type | `complexWallModel` | choice |  | Should we use tables to vary tau/beta based on CLT/MAP, or just with fixed values? |
| Evaporation time constant - tau | `wwaeTau` | Seconds | 0 … 3 | Evaporation time constant for the Basic fuel-film model, in seconds. Higher values make the film respond more slowly. | Fuel deposition fraction - beta | `wwaeBeta` | Fraction | 0 … 1 | Fraction of injected fuel deposited on the wall in the Basic model. 0.20 represents 20%. Larger values increase modeled deposition. Effective values below 0.01 bypass compensation. Downstream controller limits still apply. |
